runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game jd_l7 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics 0 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-dcs/jd-switch-edges-54-58-61-71-77.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Each set_switch holds one public level for 2 s; the snapshot after it records the ROM's T.1 display and the watched public switch levels. Mechanics stay disabled because jd_handleMech would otherwise overwrite 77, 71 and 54-58 every frame.
